tasks.title: Urban wildlife in our city
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
In your English class you have been discussing how to manage urban wildlife in towns and cities. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

What is the most important issue to address when managing urban wildlife?

Notes

Write about:

1. preventing damage to property
2. protecting animal welfare
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Urban wildlife workshop review
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement in your college English-language magazine.

Reviews wanted!

Have you attended a workshop about urban wildlife in your area? We want to hear about your experience. Write a review of the workshop for our magazine.

Describe what the workshop covered and how it was organised. Explain whether it changed how you think about urban wildlife. Would you recommend it to other residents?

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Living with urban wildlife
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement on a community website.

Articles wanted!

Living with urban wildlife

Our programme coordinator wants to hear from young people about urban wildlife in our town. Write an article for the community website.

Describe one problem that urban wildlife causes in your neighbourhood. Suggest a practical way that residents could help solve it. Explain why your idea would benefit both people and animals.

We will publish the best articles on our website.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Urban wildlife project
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You have received this email from your English-speaking friend, Chris.

From: Chris
Subject: Urban wildlife project

Hi,
I heard that your neighbourhood is starting a project to manage urban wildlife. I'm thinking of starting something similar here. Could you tell me what the main issue is in your area? What practical steps have you taken? And how can I get my neighbours interested?

Thanks a lot!
Chris

Write your email.
